name: Ghost Walker Post
summary: In central Desolace, Ghost Walker Post holds its ground beside the Kodo Graveyard. Tauren and orcs defend the Horde outpost from centaur clans and the Burning Blade, while its shamans tend dying kodos and their spirits.

sections.title: A Watch on the Wastes
sections.body: Ghost Walker Post gives the Horde a foothold on central Desolace’s dusty flats. Centaur marauders and Burning Blade cultists roam nearby, keeping the post in danger. Its facilities offer only the bare essentials. There is no inn or flight master. Tauren guards and an orcish detachment sent by Warchief Thrall keep watch over the badlands.

sections.title: Guardians of the Graveyard
sections.body:
Gurda Wildmane, a tauren shaman, leads Ghost Walker Post beside the Kodo Graveyard. Shamans tend the dying kodos who come there to perish. They ease the beasts into the next life and commune with their lingering spirits.

The post’s defenders stay ready against threats. Here, the tauren honor their ancient bond with the mighty kodo.

faq.answer: Ghost Walker Post is a small, rugged Horde outpost in central Desolace, held mainly by tauren with support from an orcish garrison.
Gurda Wildmane, a tauren shaman, leads Ghost Walker Post and tends its defenses and the neighboring Kodo Graveyard.

faq.q: Why is the post located near the Kodo Graveyard?
faq.answer: Gurda Wildmane and fellow tauren shamans live at the post to ease dying kodos into the next life and commune with the spirits of fallen beasts.

faq.q: What enemies does Ghost Walker Post fight?
faq.answer: The garrison fights hostile centaur clans and Burning Blade forces operating across Desolace.

faq.q: Can I get a flight path or rest at an inn here?
faq.answer: No. Ghost Walker Post has neither an inn nor a flight master. Travelers must seek transport elsewhere, such as Shadowprey Village.

faq.q: How does it compare to Shadowprey Village?
faq.answer: Shadowprey Village is a protected troll enclave on Desolace’s western coast. Ghost Walker Post lies inland, exposed to nearby threats, and focuses on frontier defense and spiritual duties.

angles.text: As a tauren, you see your people’s sacred duty to the natural world in their guardianship beside the kodo’s ancestral resting grounds.
Under Gurda Wildmane, the shamans here speak with ancient spirits and ease dying beasts into the spirit world.
